name: D1 library dock
description: Opens an isolated software fixture project, then with real X input drives the Library tab of the bottom dock (Phase 1 D1): the paged built-in grid with supplier, stock and price columns, the category tree (Passives > Resistor), a part's symbol and footprint preview, the Footprint and 3D kinds (footprints with the parts that use them; the generated 3D body), Place on schematic plus a click on the sheet running PlaceSymbol, the Project scope then listing the part (placing copied it into the project library), offline mode keeping only the built-in and project scopes, the common-parts palette arming the Place tool with a package variant, the Standardisation view showing the SOURCING findings and what it does not check, Manage keeping the part editor, and the Distributor scope saying the build has no distributor. Drag-to-place uses HTML5 drag and drop, which XTest cannot drive reliably; it is covered by unit tests (shell/libraryDockView.test.tsx, tools/schematic/dragPlacement.test.tsx).
